workarounds.symptom: [BUG]: Calculator reports a Python syntax error instead of Unknown conversion for unsupported units
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(calculator): report unknown conversions instead of a parser error. Target files: src/skillevaluator/tier3/reference_skills/calculator/scripts/calc.py, tests/test_reference_calculator.py, CHANGELOG.md. The calculator SKILL.md troubleshooting table says an unsupported conversion reports `Unknown conversion` and lists the supported units, but `calc.py` never printed that. A request in the `<number> <unit> to <unit>` shape with a pair outside `CONVERSIONS` made `try_conversion()` return `None`, so `main()` passed it to ... (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/859)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG]: Task-list helper loses a task whose description contains a line break
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(task-list): keep descriptions with line breaks on one line. Target files: src/skillevaluator/tier3/reference_skills/task-list/scripts/tasks.py, tests/test_reference_skill_scripts.py, CHANGELOG.md. The task-list reference helper stores one task per line in its Markdown state file, but `add` wrote the description as given. A description with a line break was split across two lines that the loader can't parse, so the task was reported as added and then disappeared: `list` showed `No tasks`, `start --task_id task_1` fai... (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/799)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG]: Tier 3 OpenCode with-skill trials fail with EPIPE: broken pipe, write; the baseline never does
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tier3): turn off OpenCode snapshots to stop with-skill EPIPE exits. Target files: src/skillevaluator/tier3/harbor/installed_agents.py, tests/tier3/test_opencode_snapshot_config.py, CHANGELOG.md. Tier 3 OpenCode with-skill trials in Docker could exit 1 with `EPIPE: broken pipe, write` after a complete answer (`"reason":"stop"`). Those trials were then marked unscoreable. The no-skill baseline never failed. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/763)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG]: Calculator reference skill rejects negative values in conversions and percentages and ignores trailing input
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(calculator): accept signed values and reject trailing input in conversions. Target files: src/skillevaluator/tier3/reference_skills/calculator/scripts/calc.py, tests/test_reference_calculator.py, CHANGELOG.md. The calculator reference skill parsed conversions and percentages with `re.match(r"([\d.]+)...")`. That rejected negative values (`-40 celsius to fahrenheit` failed with `Error: invalid syntax`) and, since the pattern wasn't anchored at the end, quietly ignored anything after a match: `10% of 50 + 5` printed `... (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/737)

workarounds.symptom: doctor crashes with ModuleNotFoundError on a base install without the tier3 extra
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Report the missing tier3 extra from doctor on a base install. Target files: src/skillevaluator/cli.py, src/skillevaluator/tier3/extras.py, tests/test_cli.py. On a base install (`pip install skillevaluator`, no `tier3` extra), `skillevaluator doctor`, `doctor --tier 3`, `doctor --tier all`, `health-check` and `tier3 doctor` crash with a `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'harbor'` traceback. `doctor` is the first readiness command a new user runs, so they get a stack trace instead of a setup hint. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/626)

workarounds.symptom: Tier 3 Compose sidecars fail when the shell exports a short sensitive-named flag
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(tier3): stop short host flags from blocking Compose sidecar values. Target files: src/skillevaluator/tier3/harbor/secure_docker_environment.py, tests/test_harbor_secure_docker_environment.py, CHANGELOG.md. Tier 3 tasks with Compose sidecars no longer fail because the shell exports a short flag with a sensitive-looking name. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/598)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG]: Reports crash on Linux when a skill file name is not valid UTF-8
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(reporting): write reports for non-UTF-8 file names and keep SARIF URIs valid. Target files: ci/native_reports.py, ci/report_views.py, ci/run_tiers.py. . Follows #519 with the other cases where SkillEvaluator either failed to write its reports for an unusual file name or wrote a SARIF `artifactLocation.uri` that does not identify the file. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/536)

workarounds.symptom: [FEA]: Distinguish Semgrep file-level parse errors from a failed scan in Code Risk Analysis
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Report Semgrep file-level parse errors as a partial scan. Target files: src/skillevaluator/models/result.py, src/skillevaluator/reporting/json_reporter.py, src/skillevaluator/reporting/retained.py. Semgrep file-level parse errors now produce one partial-scan message that names up to 20 unparsed files, relative to the skill and with the line of the first error, instead of the first three truncated errors. Every unparsed file is listed in the `semgrep_unparsed_files` field of the JSON report. The check stays `incomplete` ... (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator/pull/475)
